notes.title: Chair Lifts 🚠
notes.content:
Hi everyone 👋 and welcome to the realm of ski 🚠

In this dev' update I will talk about the lifts of Skingdom. There will be four different types of lifts : 

- Ski lifts (sometimes called “Surface lifts”)
- Chair lifts
- Gondola lifts
- Cable car lifts

Each lift type will have its own appearance of course but also different properties that will make them more or less fitted for some situations.

In this first update we will talk about chair lifts, and I will introduce the other lift types in the future! 

Let’s go 🏂

[h2]Fixed chair lifts[/h2]

Chair lifts can be fixed or disengageable, what’s the difference ?

Well, with fixed chair lifts the vehicle is attached to the cable all the time, so the chairs will move at the same speed as the cable through all the track.

It’s a simple and cheaper installation than disengageable chair lifts but it have some drawbacks. Because the vehicles go at the same speed all the time, even at embarking or disembarking the speed of the cable can’t be too high, otherwise it would be dangerous to hop on the chair due to the speed difference between skiers and the vehicles.

This forces the cable to run pretty slowly, leading to a long travel time and reduced rate!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464524/f2511f72148cacb9e94361a067f366e1e40b81fa.png[/img]
[i]Here is a screenshot of the work in progress version of the fixed chair lifts[/i]

[h2]Disengageable chair lifts[/h2]

On disengageable chair lifts the vehicles are removed from the cable when reaching the bottom or top stations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464524/de0a0881c4f3525aea2332b00b03e697109ccb74.png[/img]
[i]Here you can see the difference between the claws of fixed (left) and disengageable (right) vehicles[/i]

When removed from the cable the vehicles travel on a specific track generally using tires that go way slower than the cable track.

You already know the huge benefits of this system, since the speed can be reduced in the stations, embarking and disembarking is way easier and less dangerous. And because we can have a different speed in stations that on the cable, we can have a cable that is very fast, reducing the travel time and increasing the rate significantly!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464524/13823532ba9e5f9a9b8f8266d0a9b9eeb8115ba9.gif[/img]
[i]Here you can see the vehicles slowing down when reaching the bottom station[/i]

That’s all for today! Next time we will talk about the gondola lifts which works the same way as disengageable chair lifts! 

Thanks for reading this small update!
If you want to learn more about Skingdom and participate in the playtests this summer [url=http://skingdom.net/#newsletter]subscribe to the newsletter[/url]
Take care, and see you soon in the realm of ski!

Yannis.

notes.title: The talents system to improve your ski resort
notes.content:
[b]Hello fellow ski resort builders 👋😎[/b]

I’m happy to write this first small blog post in which I will give you more details about Skingdom 🚠
Today, let me introduce you the talent system, which is a gameplay mechanic I personally love 😁

So, in Skingdom you will be able to unlock talent points in two ways :
- Spending a predetermined amount of money
- Reaching some key points in the life of your ski resort (like welcoming 250 guests or building your 20th slope)

Then, unlock talents by spending points in one of the three talent trees :
- Ecology
- Company
- Development

Each tree contains 16 unique talents that will help you improve your resort in different ways.
Additionally, each tree will offer you 4 “special” talents that will only be available when spending 4, 6, 8 and 10 points in it.

Here is the original sketch for the talents UI in the game I drew a few months ago :

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464524/81431da11fc3c384bf147ef1ef539b9a91af7f0b.png[/img]

And here is the actual state of the UI design (don’t mind the weird colors and icons, it’s still work in progress) :

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464524/6055a644b3f5ddf93687c8f4490eafb777238c9c.png[/img]

Here is an example of a talent for each tree 👇

[table]
[tr][td][b] [/b][/td][td][b]Ecology[/b][/td][td][b]Company[/b][/td][td][b]Development[/b][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][b]Name[/b][/td][td]Lift recycling[/td][td]Headhunter[/td][td]Improved markup[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][b]Description[/b][/td][td]You recycle ski lifts better, which increases the money collected by destroying them[/td][td]Reduces the base salary of employees offered during recruitment[/td][td]Improves slopes markings and reduces the number of accidents[/td][/tr]
[/table]

And that’s it for today! Hope you enjoyed this small sneak peak 😊
Don’t forget to [url=http://skingdom.net]subscribe to the Skingdom’s newsletter if you want to learn more about the game.[/url]

See you soon in the realm of ski!
Take care,

Yannis.
